definition: 1 if a usable numeric artifact was recovered; 0.5 if only a figure or summary view was present; 0 if the task product was absent.
Pearson correlation of per-sample Shannon diversity between two sessions of the same model and prompt, using shared sample IDs (at least 30).
Mean absolute difference of per-sample Shannon diversity on the same shared samples.
Pearson correlation of the upper triangles of aligned distance matrices. Metric priority: weighted UniFrac, then Bray-Curtis, then unweighted UniFrac.
Procrustes disparity between the first two principal coordinates of the same aligned distance matrices.

Overlap of genus names called significant in a resistance-associated contrast (HG64, HF12, or resistant). Adjusted P < 0.05 when an adjusted P is available for at least 20% of rows; otherwise nominal P < 0.05. Time point is ignored.
Same call rule as 16S differential abundance, using species names.
Same calls keyed by time point and taxon.
Spearman correlation of median signed effects (log2 fold change or model coefficient) for taxa tested in both sessions. Requires at least 8 shared taxa.
